description: Fallback for when you cannot reach a browser tab signed in to Google. Queues a server-side pull of the listing's newest reviews (the same worker as the site's form) and scores it. Ask the user first: it spends one of their server-side fetches for the month (check_place's serverFetch block says how many are left). Returns the job's progress; call again with job_id every 10-15 seconds until status is done (the result is then in the response) or failed (nothing is spent). Takes a Maps link, including share short-links, or a place_id. A place that is already scored returns its result without a fetch.

job_id.description: A job from an earlier call: returns its progress, or the result once done.

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: any Google Maps place link, share short-links included (the server's browser expands them).

name: fetch_place_reviews
title: Have the server fetch the reviews (spends a monthly server fetch)
